question: Which of the following programmes is NOT a part of the Tenth Five-Year Plan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Drought Prone Area Programme** is not a part of the Tenth Five-Year Plan.
 
• The Tenth Five-Year Plan (2002-2007) of India primarily focused on various developmental and socio-economic goals, but the Drought Prone Area Programme was not included in this plan.
